§6Lithium Ion Battery§f

§aA portable energy storage item you can carry.§f
The §bLithium Ion Battery§f is an item (not a block) that stores §b800,000 RF§f and transfers up to §b80,000 RF/t§f. Charge it in any FE-powered charger or machine, then carry it around to power tools or emergency setups.

Craft it with §bLithium-6§f cells, §bAdvanced Plating§f, and wiring. It's a mid-game item that's genuinely useful for exploration and mobile power needs when you're away from your base.

§ePS:§f The battery recharges in any NC machine that accepts FE. The Nuclear Furnace works in a pinch if you don't have a dedicated charger yet.
